description: WANTED: Jai'vhanel Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine. Requirements: - Feather of Jai'vhanel
name: WANTED: Jai'vhanel
